scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p='../scripts/git-info.cjs';if(fs.existsSync(p)){require(p).writeMobileVersionFile();}else{console.warn('[shelv-mobile] scripts/git-info.cjs not found, using existing version.ts');}"
scripts.build:web: pnpm run prebuild && expo export --platform web && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('public/manifest.json', 'dist/manifest.json'); require('fs').cpSync('public/favicon.svg', 'dist/favicon.svg'); const idx='dist/index.html'; let c=require('fs').readFileSync(idx,'utf8'); c=c.replace('<title>shelv.ai Scanner</title>', '<title>סורק נייד | shelv.ai Scanner</title>'); require('fs').writeFileSync(idx,c);"
